UPDATE contact_sharing_connections 
SET status = 'active', updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE (receiverId = 870413 OR sharerId = 870413) 
  AND status = 'pending';

-- 验证更新结果
SELECT * FROM contact_sharing_connections 
WHERE receiverId = 870413 OR sharerId = 870413;
